purpose: Separate the upstream raw Android clock pseudorange contract from the optional enriched-column consistency diagnostic.

forbidden_inputs: ground_truth.csv before the post-seal train score
device WLS/SvPosition/SvElevation columns as estimator input

fixed_raw_clock_rule.receiver_epoch: Use exact integer TimeNanos - segment_base_FullBiasNanos; segment base is the first valid raw row and is replaced only when successive TimeNanos differs by strictly more than 1 second (1000000000 ns), matching gnsslog2obs.m:103-121.
fixed_raw_clock_rule.tow_receiver: floor((TimeNanos-baseFullBiasNanos)/1e9/604800) determines the GPS week; TOW subtracts BiasNanos/1e9. Floating intermediate conversion is long double; no float64 subtraction of large nanosecond values.

tow_transmit.GPS_Galileo_QZSS: ReceivedSvTimeNanos/1e9 in the corresponding GPS-week frame; QZSS/SBAS/IRNSS rows are excluded by the frozen signal map.
tow_transmit.GLONASS: Treat ReceivedSvTimeNanos as time-of-day and map against receiver TOW with -3 hours + 18 seconds and nearest day, matching glot2gpst.
tow_transmit.BeiDou: Add 14 seconds to the transmit TOW before nearest-week unwrap.

fixed_raw_clock_rule.week_unwrap: Adjust receiver-minus-transmit by integer 604800-second periods until it lies in [-302400,302400].
fixed_raw_clock_rule.per_signal_time_offset: Subtract TimeOffsetNanos/1e9 from the per-signal receiver TOW only; it does not alter the epoch key/TOW.
fixed_raw_clock_rule.pseudorange: (tow_receiver - tow_transmit) * SPEED_OF_LIGHT; reject non-finite/non-positive values and retain upstream 1e7..4e7 code mask.
fixed_raw_clock_rule.leap_second: LeapSecond is not applied to the GPS hardware-clock equation; utcTimeMillis is retained only as the integer output key. No guessed UTC/GPST offset is inserted into P.
fixed_raw_clock_rule.hardware_clock_discontinuity: Retain HardwareClockDiscontinuityCount for epoch/arc diagnostics and downstream transition gates; do not silently turn a count change into a different receiver-clock equation.
fixed_raw_clock_rule.enriched_columns: RawPseudorangeMeters, ArrivalTimeNanosSinceGpsEpoch, ReceivedSvTimeNanosSinceGpsEpoch, SvPosition*, SvElevation*, and WlsPosition* are never estimator inputs. RawPseudorangeMeters may be checked only in the legacy strict diagnostic mode; the explicit raw-clock-only mode does not parse or use it.

raw_only_execution_contract.imu_clock_flag: --android-utc-wall-clock-fallback when ChipsetElapsedRealtimeNanos is absent; this affine UTC/GPS mapping is an explicit portability fallback and never a pseudorange source
raw_only_execution_contract.production_default: unchanged; strict enriched-column verification remains default unless the explicit raw-clock-only flag is supplied
fail_closed: invalid raw week/TOW or non-finite/non-positive raw-clock range
duplicate supported satellite/signal in an epoch

synthetic_fixture_plan: raw-clock-only ignores a malformed/large RawPseudorangeMeters diagnostic column while strict mode rejects it
exact 604800-second transmit-week boundary and nearest-week unwrap
GLONASS time-of-day day-wrap and BeiDou +14 second offset
TimeOffsetNanos affects only the per-signal P
strictly-more-than-1-second TimeNanos segment reset and HardwareClockDiscontinuity diagnostic

evaluation_policy.score_gate: Do not open train truth until all three routes and all four raw-only candidate recipes produce finite, keyed, converged truth-free artifacts. No validation/holdout access in this recovery.
